description: An agent-based, network-structured simulation of mask-wearing behavior diffusion, driven by peer social influence, policy and enforcement, information and media messaging, economic access, and individual heterogeneity. Agents interact on a small-world social network and co-locate in multiple location types with policies and enforcement applied.

parameters.information_sources: Each person follows HA with prob=0.7 and media with prob=0.8

parameters.home: One per person; capacity=household size (default 1 unless extended)
parameters.store: num_stores=50; capacity~Normal(30,10) clipped>=5; mask_stock=initial per store; mask_price set from mask_price * (1+store_markup)

parameters.intervention_schedule: Mandate starts day=20; campaign starts day=10

modules.name: SocialNetworkBuilder
modules.description: Constructs and maintains the small-world peer network among persons.

update_rule.pseudocode:
On initialization:
  if network_type == 'small_world':
    graph = WattsStrogatzGraph(N=population_size, k=average_degree, p=rewire_prob)
  elif network_type == 'erdos_renyi':
    graph = ErdosRenyiGraph(N, p=average_degree/(N-1))
  else:
    graph = BarabasiAlbertGraph(N, m=max(1, average_degree//2))
  For each person i:
    Person[i].peer_network_neighbors = neighbors(graph, i)
Store graph as graph.peer_network.
No daily updates unless dynamic rewiring is added.
notes: Tick rate 0 indicates only at t=0.

modules.name: RiskSignalModule
modules.description: Generates a daily contextual exposure signal (perceived disease prevalence) that affects personal risk perception.

update_rule.pseudocode:
For day t:
  // Gaussian-shaped bump centered at peak_day with baseline
  sigma = max(1.0, 0.1 * observation_period_days)
  peak_component = risk_signal_peak_value * exp(-0.5 * ((t - risk_signal_peak_day)/sigma)^2)
  signal = clamp(risk_signal_baseline + peak_component, 0, 1)
  emit signal.risk_perceived_daily = signal
notes: This is exogenous; can be replaced by epidemiological coupling if include_disease_dynamics is enabled (frozen off here).

modules.name: InformationAndBeliefUpdate
modules.description: Broadcasts HA and media messages; updates agents’ risk perception and trust based on source credibility, bias, and prior beliefs.

notes: Combines exogenous risk signal with messaging to shape perceived risk.
message_decay_rate implements forgetting; trust_update_rate controls responsiveness.

modules.name: PolicyAndEnforcement
modules.description: Applies mask mandates to locations, allocates enforcement resources, and executes enforcement events affecting compliance and future adoption.

notes: Enforcement acts on observed non-compliance in locations.
Compliance decay can be applied downstream in AdoptionDecision via compliance_decay_rate.

requirements: access to current occupancy by location

modules.name: EconomicAccessAndSupply
modules.description: Manages mask stock and pricing in stores; persons purchase/replace masks based on access, price, and income.

notes: Simplified purchase decision; any store could be selected (random store).
Income and price elasticities shape purchase probability multiplicatively.

modules.name: MobilityAndInteractions
modules.description: Assigns daily locations to persons (home, work/school, stores, transport), hosts interactions, and computes masked contact share.

notes: Contact weights differ by location type; occupancy also supports enforcement sampling.

modules.name: AdoptionDecision
modules.description: Computes daily mask-wearing decisions per person using weighted social influence, personal risk, policy pressure, cost/access, and stochasticity.

update_rule.pseudocode:
For each person i:
  peer_adoption = mean(Person[j].mask_adoption_state for j in neighbors(i)) if neighbors else 0
  social_term = Person[i].social_influence_susceptibility * (peer_adoption - peer_threshold)
  risk_term = personal_risk_weight * Person[i].risk_perception
  policy_term = policy_weight * expected_policy_pressure_for_person(i) // based on today's primary visited location
  cost_term = - Person[i].cost_sensitivity * (1 - Person[i].access_to_masks)
  base_propensity = social_influence_weight * social_term + risk_term + policy_term + cost_term
  // Compliance base with decay (habit erosion)
  compliance = policy_compliance_base_rate * exp(-compliance_decay_rate * max(0, day - mandate_start_day)) if day >= mandate_start_day else 0
  noise = Normal(0, epsilon_std)
  p_wear = sigmoid(base_propensity + compliance + noise)
  Person[i].mask_adoption_state = Bernoulli(p_wear)
notes: Expected policy pressure is looked up from PolicyAndEnforcement for the person's main location.
Cost term penalizes if access_to_masks is false.

modules.name: AggregationAndMetrics
modules.description: Computes observables and summary statistics each day and at the end of simulation.

update_rule.pseudocode:
adoption_rate = mean(Person.mask_adoption_state)
append_to_series('adoption_rate_daily', adoption_rate)
append_to_series('both_masked_contact_share_daily', signal.both_masked_contact_share_daily)
append_to_series('enforcement_actions_per_day', signal.enforcement_actions_today)
// Adoption by location type using today's occupancy
for each location type T in {work, school, transport, store}:
  occupants = union of occupancy_by_location[L] for L of type T
  rate_T = mean(Person[i].mask_adoption_state for i in occupants) if occupants else 0
  record observable.adoption_rate_T
// Churn rate
if day > 0:
  churn = mean(1 if Person[i].mask_adoption_state != state_yesterday[i] else 0 for i)
  append_to_series('adoption_churn_rate_daily', churn)
state_yesterday = current states snapshot
// If end of sim:
if day == observation_period_days - 1:
  final_adoption_rate = last('adoption_rate_daily')
  t50 = first day t where adoption_rate_daily[t] >= 0.5 or NaN if never
  sustained70 = count of t where adoption_rate_daily[t] >= adoption_threshold_high
  gini = gini_coefficient(adoption by income groups) with smoothing epsilon
  did_effect = mean(adoption_rate_daily[mandate_start_day+1 : mandate_start_day+did_post_period_days]) - mean(adoption_rate_daily[mandate_start_day - did_pre_period_days : mandate_start_day-1])
  emit all final aggregates
notes: Gini computed on group means by income quantiles.
DiD is simplified single-group pre/post; extendable to treatment/control if multiple regions.

agents.distributions: as specified in Person.initialization.parameters and global parameters

algorithms.WattsStrogatzGraph: Generates small-world network with N nodes, k neighbors, rewire prob p.
algorithms.DeGrootBeliefUpdate: Weighted averaging of prior belief and signals from credible sources with decay.
algorithms.LogisticAdoption: p = 1/(1+exp(-z)) from weighted sum of drivers and noise.
algorithms.PoissonInteractions: Draw number of interactions per location per day from Poisson(lambda).
algorithms.DifferenceInDifferences: Estimate policy effect from mean(post) - mean(pre) vs baseline.
algorithms.GiniCoefficient: Compute inequality of adoption across income groups.
algorithms.BernoulliStochasticDecision: Sample binary adoption from probability p.
